english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for progress or improvement, such as in health, knowledge, or ability.
This is the all-purpose choice for improvement or development to a better state.
Use 進步 as the all-purpose noun for general progress or improvement, including advancement in learning.
Use this when the emphasis is on progress or becoming better, especially for a person, skill, or performance.

examples.english: The advance in my Cantonese has been obvious lately.
examples.traditional: 我學廣東話進步咗好多。
